'''May 2001 Lancaster, California tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Lancaster, California on 25 May 2001. [[Dunya Ertan]] won it. It is known from Dunya Ertan's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2371">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-26-lancaster-ca-home-of-the-practice-decksd2371/ lancaster-ca-home-of-the-practice-decks], DeckTech (Dunya "Hardpack" Ertan, 26 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-26-lancaster-ca-home-of-the-practice-decksd2371/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 25 May 2001
* '''Site:''' Lancaster, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Dunya Ertan]]
